flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob,helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper (queryRecordsForReminder, batchPreloadContactInfo, refreshContactInfo, refreshIndividualContactInfo, refreshCompanyContactInfo, updateOcmsContactInfo, validateContactInfo, loadAllExcludedIds)}, framework/controllers/CombinedSchedulerTriggerController, cron-schedules-prod.properties. Other repos: no code specific to this story.
note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%). The same eNotification job handles ENA and the post-letter reminders (RD1 to DR3), so a hirer whose 2nd letter was already sent (last stage RD2) is processed: the job prepares contacts (DataHive Singpass refresh for individuals, CorpPass for companies), validates mobile/email, and skips opt-outs/passports. Partial because the DataHive refresh is controlled by cron.enareminder.datahive, which is false in dev/uat/prod, so the mobile/email stored in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver is used, and because the job is switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false) in every environment and only runs by manual trigger. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 ('Awaiting eNotification cron to activate') confirms the cron is not yet active. There is no hirer-specific filter (offender_indicator 'Y'). The story mentions DOS and Vault; the code uses DataHive, whether that is DOS/Vault: cannot verify from repo. Per-environment property values in Azure: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Partial claim: the contact check and opt-out logic for stage RD2 exists, but the DataHive refresh and the eNotification cron are off in the properties

steps.step: After the 2nd letter (RD2) is sent, OCMS selects the hirer notices that need an electronic reminder
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder picks notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3) whose due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) is inside the ENOTEDAYS window of that stage, offender_indicator 'Y' (the current offender, including a hirer), no send record yet at that stage, not an I/D/V vehicle, and no revival between the two processing dates (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1076-1167). The job tags each record with nextProcessingStage = last stage, so a notice whose 2nd letter was already sent (RD2) is processed with stage RD2 (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162, 174-180). Partial because cron.notification.enabled=false in dev/uat/prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), so the job only runs by manual trigger (CombinedSchedulerTriggerController.java:105-108); OCMS-DF-2026-180 says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. The join to ocms_parameter ENOTEDAYS for code RD2 is an INNER JOIN (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1107-1110), so without that parameter row no RD2 notice is selected; parameter content in the DB and Azure values: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest mobile number / email from the data source (Epic OCMS9) and updates the hirer data
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo then refreshContactInfo per notice (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). When enabled, individuals are looked up in DataHive Singpass (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2760) and companies in CorpPass (2496-2530), and the new mobile/email is written to ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver through updateOcmsContactInfo (2800-2828). But refreshContactInfo returns early with the stored contact when cron.enareminder.datahive is not 'true' (2461-2475; preload 2325-2335) and the property is false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So in the repo configuration the latest-contact check does not run. Whether DataHive = 'DOS'/'Vault' in the story: cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notices without a valid contact (individual without mobile, company without email) are skipped
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with a contactError, individuals without phoneNo, and companies (id_type B) without email (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290). In the job, failed records are skipped with a log; for reminder stages there is no stage patch (only ENA is redirected to RD1) (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266), and companies are not part of the SMS batch (269-285). Same logic as OCMS11.8.

steps.step: A hirer who opted out or has a passport is not sent an electronic reminder
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1134); the job loads the whole exclusion list once (loadAllExcludedIds, 1207-1216; NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:194) and skips excluded records or id_type P/PASSPORT before the SMS batch is prepared (226-241). For reminder stages the notice stage is left unchanged, so letters continue on the paper track. The exclusion list content is DB data: cannot verify from repo.
